set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "Build static vendored dependencies" FORCE)

set(FMT_DOC OFF CACHE BOOL "Vendored fmt documentation sources are not included" FORCE)
set(FMT_TEST OFF CACHE BOOL "Vendored fmt test sources are not included" FORCE)
set(FMT_FUZZ OFF CACHE BOOL "Vendored fmt fuzzing sources are not included" FORCE)
set(FMT_CUDA_TEST OFF CACHE BOOL "Vendored fmt CUDA test sources are not included" FORCE)
set(FMT_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "Do not install the vendored fmt dependency separately" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(fmt EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)

set(BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "Vendored pareto example sources are not included" FORCE)
set(BUILD_PYTHON_BINDING OFF CACHE BOOL "Vendored pareto Python binding sources are not included" FORCE)
set(BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "Vendored pareto test sources are not included" FORCE)
set(BUILD_TARGET_WITH_ALL_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "Vendored pareto test sources are not included" FORCE)
set(BUILD_BENCHMARKS OFF CACHE BOOL "Vendored pareto benchmark sources are not included" FORCE)
set(BUILD_MATPLOT_TARGETS OFF CACHE BOOL "Vendored pareto plotting examples are not included" FORCE)
set(BUILD_INSTALLER OFF CACHE BOOL "Do not install the vendored pareto dependency separately" FORCE)
set(BUILD_PACKAGE OFF CACHE BOOL "Do not package the vendored pareto dependency separately" FORCE)
set(BUILD_WITH_PEDANTIC_WARNINGS OFF CACHE BOOL "prevent pareto from adding /WX" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(pareto EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)

set(JSONCPP_WITH_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "Vendored JsonCpp test sources are not included" FORCE)
set(JSONCPP_WITH_POST_BUILD_UNITTEST OFF CACHE BOOL "Vendored JsonCpp test sources are not included" FORCE)
set(JSONCPP_WITH_WARNING_AS_ERROR OFF CACHE BOOL "Do not treat JsonCpp warnings as errors" FORCE)
set(JSONCPP_WITH_STRICT_ISO OFF CACHE BOOL "Disable JsonCpp strict ISO warnings" FORCE)
set(JSONCPP_WITH_PKGCONFIG_SUPPORT OFF CACHE BOOL "Disable JsonCpp pkg-config installation" FORCE)
set(JSONCPP_WITH_CMAKE_PACKAGE OFF CACHE BOOL "Disable JsonCpp CMake package installation" FORCE)
set(JSONCPP_WITH_EXAMPLE OFF CACHE BOOL "Vendored JsonCpp example sources are not included" FORCE)
set(JSONCPP_STATIC_WINDOWS_RUNTIME OFF CACHE BOOL "Use the shared Windows runtime" FORCE)
set(BUILD_STATIC_LIBS ON CACHE BOOL "Build the static JsonCpp library" FORCE)
set(BUILD_OBJECT_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "Do not build the JsonCpp object library" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(jsoncpp EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
